overview: The Mindcore is the heart of Grieg’s madness.
details: Here, Grieg’s psychic imprint is strongest. Spatial implosions distort the chamber, void fractures tear through reality, and mind‑echoes manifest as hostile entities. The Mindcore Avatar embodies Grieg’s deepest madness.
hooks: A void fracture expands, threatening total collapse.
A mind‑echo manifests as a twisted version of Grieg.
Spatial implosion pulls debris into a singularity.
The Mindcore Avatar awakens, warping nearby geometry.
